title: Palindrome Number
description: Given an integer x, return true if x is a palindrome integer, and false otherwise. A palindrome integer reads the same backward as forward.

hints.content: Reverse the digits and compare with the original.

solution.code: function solve(input) { const { x } = input; if (x < 0) return false; let rev = 0, n = x; while (n > 0) { rev = rev * 10 + (n % 10); n = Math.floor(n / 10); } return rev === x; }
solution.explanation: Build the reversed number digit by digit, then compare with the original input.
